links.outcome: Expert-panel accuracy of ChatGPT answers to post-tonsillectomy parent questions against clinical knowledge
links.effect: Pain management mean satisfaction 3.67 and follow-up 2.67 (of 5); recommended codeine for children despite black-box warning; suggested 1-week follow-up vs customary 2-4 weeks.
links.quote: Pain management and follow-up recommendations were inaccurate, including a recommendation to prescribe codeine to children despite a black-box warning, and a suggested post-operative follow-up at 1 week, rather than the customary 2-4 weeks for our panel.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline accuracy and utility for post-operative pediatric tonsillectomy questions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
